comparison.objective: Load four square blanks into a close-clearance gravity magazine; candidate separates media from retained washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated yaw squaring, centering and insertion of individual rigid blanks versus bimanual screen manipulation and orientation-dependent passage of many loose bodies.
comparison.success_condition: Each blank wholly inside, flat, supported and at rest, scored by count versus ≥98% media mass in receiver with every washer remaining in the screen.
comparison.reason: Gravity and an opening are shared only superficially: the record tests precision one-part-at-a-time magazine loading, not selective bulk sieving and retention.
